name: Health, safety, security and environment
description: Health, safety, security and environment for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. EPC indirect. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: Safety and Health Officer (SHO) statut — project contract price threshold making SHO appointment mandatory for builders
specifications.basis: DOSH 'Petunjuk Prestasi SHO / SHO Performance Indicators' page read 25 Nov 2026, 'Updated Date: 16/03/2026': 'The appointment of an SHO is encouraged among client companies and designers, but mandatory for builders if the construction work has a total project contract price exceeding RM20 million.' Regulation 12 of the Safety and Health Officer Regulations 1997 allows DOSH to refuse renewal of SHO

specifications.metric: Safety and Health Officer / safety — maximum fine for contravention of Act 514 sections 15-18B
specifications.basis: Act 514 Occupational Safety and Health Act 1994 reprint as at 1 June 2024 (latest amendment Act A1648 in operation 1 June 2024), section 19: fine not exceeding five hundred thousand ringgit or imprisonment not exceeding two years, or both.

specifications.metric: Safety and Health Officer / safety — contract price threshold requiring a Safety and Health Officer
specifications.basis: DOSH Guidelines for Public Safety and Health at Construction Sites, 1st Revision 2007, cl.6.4: 'Every contractor of any building operation and works of engineering construction when the total contract price of the project exceeds twenty million ringgit Malaysia, they shall employ a safety and health officer' (section 29 Act 514; OSH (Safety and Health Officer) Order 1997).

specifications.metric: Safety and Health Officer / safety — worker count triggering a safety and health committee
specifications.basis: DOSH Guidelines 2007 cl.6.2: main contractor of a worksite in which forty or more persons are employed (by him or other contractors) shall establish a safety and health committee (section 30 Act 514; Regulations 1997).

specifications.metric: Safety and Health Officer / safety — principal's duty to allocate time, budget and resources for safety
specifications.basis: Act 514 (as at 1 June 2024) section 18A(3)(b): measures necessary include 'the allocation of sufficient time, budget and other resources' for safety in construction work activities; section 18B requires risk assessment and implementation of controls.

specifications.metric: Environmental Impact Assessment fo — capacity threshold for prescribed fossil-fuel steam power station
specifications.basis: Environmental Quality (Prescribed Activities) (EIA) Order 2015, P.U. (A) 195, made 5 August 2015, First Schedule item 11(a): 'Construction of steam generated power station using fossil fuels (other than coal) and having the capacity of 10 megawatts or more, with or without transmission line'; clause 4(2)(a) applies subitems 11(a) and (b) to Sabah.

specifications.metric: Environmental Impact Assessment fo — Sabah application of the EIA Order
specifications.basis: EIA Order 2015 clause 4(2): applies to Sabah for First Schedule items 2, 6, 9 and 14 and subitems 11(a) and (b), and Second Schedule items 2, 6, 9, 11, 14 and 17; clause 2 defines 'environmentally sensitive area' to include areas specified under any Enactment in the State of Sabah.

specifications.metric: Environmental Impact Assessment fo — site hoarding minimum height (public safety)
specifications.basis: DOSH Guidelines 2007 cl.11.2, cross-listed here as public-safety control: hoarding not less than 1800 mm and continuous to the ground; cl.11.6 requires security against unauthorised entry.
The appointment of an SHO is encouraged among client companies and designers, but mandatory for builders if the construction work has a total project contract price exceeding RM20 million

safety and health officers (SHOs) were established by the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA). The specific responsibilities of an SHO are set out in the Occupational Safety and Health (Safety and Health Officer) Regulations
specifications.value: Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA); Occupational Safety and Health (Safety and Health Officer) Regulations

specifications.basis: Regulation 12, Occupational Safety and Health (Safety and Health Officers) Regulations 1997 states that the Director General of DOSH may refuse to renew the registration of an SHO if he fails to carry out his duties
specifications.value: Regulation 12, Occupational Safety and Health (Safety and Health Officers) Regulations 1997 - Director General may refuse to renew registration if duties not carried out

specifications.basis: These SHO Performance Indicators ... are leading indicators of: employer commitment; legal compliance; employee involvement; and the effectiveness of control measures
specifications.value: leading indicators of employer commitment, legal compliance, employee involvement, and effectiveness of control measures

specifications.basis: SHO must fill in the total indicators achieved for each performance in a given month, except for the Total Notices Received (items 23 – 25)
specifications.value: SHO fills total indicators achieved each month except Total Notices Received (items 23-25), which cover the whole project period

specifications.basis: Consultation is a legal requirement. Workers should be consulted ...
specifications.value: Occupational Safety and Health (Safety and Health Committee) Regulations; Factories and Machinery (Building Operations and Engineering Construction Works) (Safety) Regulations

gaps.why: No project-specific HSSE budget, incident statistics, HSE plan or ISO 45001/14001 certificate for the 7-unit plant was found. The EIA Order 2015 text read has no explicit gas-engine-plant entry, so its applicability to this plant is not established.
gaps.next_action: Confirm EIA classification with DOE Sabah, and obtain the contractor's HSSE plan and certification evidence before pricing.

gaps.why: No published HSSE budget, Malakoff 'Penalties for HSSE Offences Procedure (MCSS2-14)' penalty schedule, or project-specific EIA/HSSE cost for the 7-unit GEG plant was found. The Malakoff RFQ (6 Mar 2025) names the penalty procedure but its figures were not in the readable document; the printed rates
gaps.next_action: Obtain MCSS2-14 and the priced HSSE preliminaries from the employer/bidder; keep the two ISO 14001 editions side by side and confirm which edition the contract requires.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
